a15.body: A demo session opens two example farms — one crop, one tree — with plots, sixty days of imagery, advice, tasks and a team, in your chosen language.

a15.r3: Nothing is saved, no account is created, and closing the app ends it.
a15.r4: Anything that genuinely needs an account offers to create one.
